_doc: Hand-entered ore data, merged into ores.json by build_reference.py, which never writes this file. `spots` adds a place whose rock mix comes from the game's mining presets named in `mixes`; use it when the game defines a mix but does not place it. `ores` sets fields on an ore entry (each field replaces the generated one, so give it its own `src`). Every entry says how it is known in `src` (game / ref / seen / user).

akiro-cluster.name: Akiro Cluster
akiro-cluster.note: The game defines the mining preset HPP_Pyro_AkiroCluster, but its container (pyro/akirocluster.socpak) is not placed in this build's Pyro hierarchy, so its link to the Akiro Cluster is by name [inference]. The Star Citizen Wiki API (4.10.3-LIVE.13165946, read 2026-11-25) also lists Riccite at the Akiro Cluster.
